intervals.description:
Intervals at which metric needs to be cached. At least one cache interval is expected. The metric will be cached
only for the interval on first evaluation for that interval.

monthsInPast.description:
Number of months in the past for which data needs to be cached. Default is 60 months = 5 years. For year interval
the number of months will be adjusted to match the next closest year boundary in the past

monthsInFuture.description:
Number of months in the future for which data needs to be cached. Default is 1 month in the future. For year interval
the number of months will be the next year boundary

title: Type to hold information about how a simple metric should be cached
name: SimpleMetricCacheSpec
